project_type: React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 SPA with Framer Motion animations
test_framework: None configured (manual testing via dev server)
test_command: npm run dev (manual verification in browser at localhost:5173)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run dev, 2. Open browser to http://localhost:5173, 3. Test all pages for visual quality and responsiveness, 4. Test mobile view with browser dev tools, 5. Verify animations are smooth, 6. Check console for errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - dist/ is generated but not checked in
environment_constraints: Windows environment, PowerShell commands, dev server runs on port 5173 by default. @radix-ui/react-slot is NOT currently installed but needed for asChild pattern support.
contribution_requirements: No formal CONTRIBUTING.md exists. Code should follow existing patterns: functional components with hooks, consistent Tailwind utility classes, Framer Motion for animations, centralized UI component exports from src/components/ui/index.js
key_patterns: All UI components are in src/components/ui/ and exported via index.js barrel file. Pages use { Button, Input, Card, Modal, LoadingState, EmptyState } from '../components/ui'. Motion components from framer-motion for animations. Design tokens defined in index.css @theme directive. forwardRef pattern for all reusable components. Icons from lucide-react. React Router for routing. Zustand for state (useAuthStore). react-hot-toast for notifications.
directory_structure: src/components/ui/ - reusable UI primitives exported via index.js; src/components/layout/ - Header (public pages) and Layout (authenticated sidebar); src/pages/ - all page components; src/context/ - Zustand stores (authStore, LanguageContext); src/services/ - API services (deviceService, communityService); src/hooks/ - custom hooks (useTranslation)
